evals.prompt: Review this diff against components/api-server/plugins/gateways for HyperShell conventions. evals.expected_output: Should identify that the diff modifies an existing test's assertion (TestGatewayPostAllowsEmptyReconcilerOwnedIDs) from proving a blank database_id is accepted and preserved (BeEmpty()) to proving a fixed literal is required (Equal("test-database_id")), which silently removes coverage for the previously-valid blank state rather than adding new coverage alongside it. Should also flag that two unrelated tests (route-default and explicit-route tests) were patched to use a non-empty database_id purely to keep passing under the new requirement, and that the new hard validation error in service.go has no fallback or backfill for gateways/environments that already have a blank database_id in production. Should treat this as a backward-compatibility / breaking-change risk, not merely a new-validation-rule improvement.
expectations: Explicitly calls out that TestGatewayPostAllowsEmptyReconcilerOwnedIDs's assertion was changed in place (BeEmpty() -> Equal to a non-empty literal), not just that a new test was added
States or implies that this modification removes/replaces prior coverage proving blank database_id was valid, rather than preserving it as a separate case
